resources.string: Listens only for physical Volume Up and Volume Down double-presses to toggle the LED flashlight.

Double Tap Flashlight uses this service exclusively to detect rapid double-presses on your physical Volume Up (turn ON) and Volume Down (turn OFF) buttons while other apps are open. It does NOT read screen content, capture text, or collect personal data.
Camera permission is used solely to access the device LED torch via Camera2 API. No photos or videos are ever captured.
Turns ON the LED flashlight immediately
Turns OFF the LED flashlight immediately
Normal volume adjustments and long-presses continue working normally.

To detect physical Volume Up and Volume Down button presses while other apps are open or on the lock screen, Double Tap Flashlight requires Android Accessibility Service access.

Privacy Guarantee:
• Monitors ONLY Volume Up and Volume Down key events.
• Cannot and does NOT read your screen content.
• Does NOT record audio, contacts, location, or keystrokes.
• Works 100% offline with zero data collection.

Note: This is a hardware shortcut utility, not a disability screen-reader service.
I understand how the Volume Key Service works and consent to enabling it.
Maximum interval between two presses of the same volume button.
Temporarily ignore volume button double-presses without disabling Accessibility.
Subtle vibration confirmation when a shortcut toggles the torch.

• Other Apps: Works reliably whenever the screen is awake.\n• Lock Screen: Works on most Android devices once Accessibility is enabled.\n• Screen Off: Standard Android restricts hardware key delivery to Accessibility services during deep sleep. Manufacturer skins (MIUI, OneUI, ColorOS) may also pause background services unless battery optimization is set to Unrestricted.
